decision_rule.extend_to_30_epochs_if: at least 75% of run-seeds have positive last-five mask-mAP slope AND at least 50% reach their best mask mAP in the final two epochs

coverage.baseline_contract: E0 and E3 cover all 128 train samples once per epoch; E3 ledger is the observed baseline coverage reference

learning_frontier.exclude: SUSPECT OR persistent conflict with normalized slope >= -0.001
learning_frontier.note: top-quartile rank alone is insufficient; the improvement and absolute-loss gates allow the selected set to shrink

loss_components.limitation: Only seed 20260810 has all real intermediate E0/E5 checkpoints; seed 20260811/12 component trajectories cannot be reconstructed after cleanup.
